property_summary: For any caller and any input, SetLogFile must bind the contract's logger to the real LogFile so that any subsequent Put (which logs via Log.AddMessage) succeeds; the mutant instead binds Log to msg.sender, so when the caller is a contract without AddMessage the later Put reverts.
change_summary: Replace the assignment so Log is set to a LogFile cast of msg.sender instead of the _log argument.
